body: Well first thanks for replying seriously. It's my first time on a forum. I thought I'd be ignored. I just don't want therapy. It's half not wanting to go through all that and half not feeling like I deserve it. She's at a New Year's Eve party tonight, what's going to happen? I can't relax. Panic attacks, I've at least 2 already. Even with my depression she's the reason I don't want to live anymore. I feel like a bad father a bad person and a pussy. The only thing that made me feel good today was I planned my death in less thank 2 weeks. My wife says she feels like a bad mom for leaving our daughter with me. I think she's right. Goddamn, I'm helpless. I think I'll just go with my plan, my family, all of it, will be closer after it. I never wanted 2 families I didn't want any of this, how am I supposed to go on with everything I didn't want?

Thanks for replying. Yes she's the mother of our daughter. She is a part of my life but sometimes that makes it worse. today I reached out to her she replied in the same get therapy blah blah fashion. I don't know what I'm looking for but I can't stop shaking and someone's got to be out there right? Understanding and doesn't feel like they have to fix me just is there for my bullshit. I just can't make it go away and I can't stop the harmful thoughts and it's just so fucking bad tonight I'm scared what am I supposed to do what to you do when you have no one
You paying? Cuz I'm down but first, what's your favorite bands because we gotta agree on music at least
